subject: Mobile Development
title: How Developers Work Around the Tax
description: A short lesson to help you apply How Developers Work Around the Tax.

hook.text: Developers can't change the rules, but they've found creative workarounds.

buildup.text: Some apps are free on mobile and sell subscriptions only through their website.

discovery.text: Others offer 'reader' apps that display purchased content but never sell inside the app.

twist.text: Apple created a special 'reader app' exception for content apps like Netflix and Kindle.

climax.text: Every workaround adds friction for users, which ultimately hurts developers' conversion rates.

punchline.text: Avoiding the tax costs users' convenience.

quiz.question: What is a 'reader app' exception?
options: Apps that display purchased content without selling inside the app
